subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` as a public opt-in sandbox config contract for deployments that preinstall skills?
rationale: The PR solves a plausible operational-cost problem, but it adds public config surface and changes the sandbox skill materialization/readability contract, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Keep the config direction, require the remote-guidance repair, then merge through normal sandbox/config owner review.

options.title: Model as backend capability
options.body: Ask for the optimization to be expressed as a sandbox-backend capability or owner API rather than a user-facing core config key.

options.title: Pause the option
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open and pause this PR until sandbox owners settle the public boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the config direction, require the remote-guidance repair, then merge through normal sandbox/config owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is sandbox/config product boundary rather than ordinary code ownership, and history shows adjacent sandbox backend work.
